testcase.name: Scenario: Retain command sort order across category switches until the dialog closes: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1740:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain command sort order across category switches until the dialog closes ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and ribbon customization is open with All Commands selected ✔ And the available commands are in ascending name order ✔ When the user clicks the available-command Name header ✔ Then the separator remains first and the commands appear in descending name order ✔ When the user selects the Sketch Tab command category ✔ Then the separator remains first and the Sketch commands appear in descending name order ✔ When the user selects All Commands again ✔ Then the available commands remain in descending name order ✔ When the user closes customization without making an edit and reopens it from Tools ✔ Then All Commands is selected and the available commands are in ascending name order ✔ And the custom-panel target remains empty
